Between 2002 and 2003 the group participated in soundtracks to such movies as "Boomer", "Day Watch" and "Hunting for a Piranha". Kukry music gradually evolved from early pop punk to this day's post punk / goth rock. The band is well-known for their soundtrack to "The 9th Company" movie.
The word "KuKryNiksy" is the name of a Soviet cartoon artist trio famous in 1940s-50s (Mikhail Kuprianov, Porfiry Krylov and Nikolay Sokolov). Read more on Last.fm

Кино  (Kino, Russian for "cinema" or "movie") was a Soviet rock band formed by Виктор Цой (Viktor Tsoi) in Leningrad (present-day St. Petersburg). They were one of the most famous Soviet new wave bands of the 1980s.
The band was formed by Tsoi, Aleksei Rybin, and Oleg Valinskiy in the summer of 1981 in Leningrad, USSR (now St. Petersburg) as a punk rock band Garin i giperboloidy (Гарин и гиперболоиды) (after a novel by Aleksey Tolstoy, Giperboloid inzhenera Garina, The Hyperboloid of Engineer Garin). lastfm.name: Victor Bermon
lastfm.bioSummary: Victor Bermon's debut is thirteen pastiches of I-can't-tell-how many other songs, thirteen simple truths fused of so many seemingly incompatible conversations. Delicately disassembled, arranged meticulously, considered carefully and then constructed as if into wondrous glass figurines, each song feels airy and effortless until listened to with a more attentive ear, at which point the complexity of their many moving parts becomes plain. Arriving at Night suggests the image of a watchmaker at work. Read more on Last.fm

lastfm.bioSummary:
Lia (りあ, born Dec. 20) is a J-pop,  trance, and techno happy hardcore singer-songwriter and artist who is best known for her work in the visual novel AIR, with melancholic songs such as Natsukage, Tori no Uta (鳥の詩) and Farewell song.
